name: 惊鸿掠水
description: 冲刺至正方向最远合法地格（8），对路径上首个敌人造成2倍伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece;var p=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:8,filter:'all'});if(!p||p.needsTargetSelection)return p;var dx=Math.sign(p.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(p.y-c.y);var tr=flow.query.tracePath(c,{x:dx,y:dy},{maxDistance:8,excludePieceId:c.instanceId,passEnemies:true});var hit=null;var encounters=tr.encounters||[];for(var i=0;i<encounters.length;i++){if(encounters[i].type!=='piece')continue;var target=flow.query.piece(encounters[i].pieceId);if(target&&target.currentHp>0&&!arePlayersAllied(battle,target.ownerPlayerId,c.ownerPlayerId)){hit=target;break;}}if(hit)dealDamage(c,hit,c.attack*2,'physical',battle,context.skill.id);var land=tr.lastLandableCell;if(land)flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:c.instanceId,x:land.x,y:land.y}],'dash',{passEnemies:true});return{success:true,message:c.name+'向正方向冲刺'};}
